caveats: DECODING: Model Thinking was DISABLED at the provider key level for every model (verified rlen==0), because with reasoning enabled the QODEC decode exceeded the provider's gateway limit (repeated HTTP 502) and was operationally infeasible. Reasoning-off is applied IDENTICALLY to both arms, so the within-model RAW-vs-QODEC comparison is controlled; but decoding a compressed legend plausibly benefits more from deliberation than reading raw JSON, so the regression is established UNDER GREEDY/NO-COT DECODING and may not hold with a large reasoning budget.

SCALE: development scale (N=3 replicates, 11 questions, single case case-0002, 33 cells/arm/model). Per the protocol this is a development signal, not a significance test; strength comes from the consistent direction across 4 independent model families, not from sample size.

ABSOLUTE BASELINE: RAW correctness is itself modest (36-70% across models) because these are small/mid open models with reasoning off; the load-bearing result is the WITHIN-MODEL relative regression, not the absolute rate.

PROVIDER: Arli AI community hosting; each key pinned to one model, reported==requested on every attempt (no substitution). Gemma-4-31B-it / GLM-4.7 / DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 reported official family names; Qwen3.5-27B-Anko is a community variant. These are the served weights.
STRUCTURAL: Q1RQ is byte-lossless (roundtrip PASS, inherited from Q2). The regression is in MODEL comprehension of the representation, not in the encoding's fidelity.
finding: Across all four model families, each qualified model answered the RAW valid context better than its byte-equivalent QODEC encoding, under identical no-reasoning decoding. The QODEC representation causes a consistent quality regression -- driven mainly by fabricated/garbled observation identifiers (RAW 3 -> QODEC 21 cells), leaked undecoded legend glyphs (0 -> 16), and more missing required witnesses (64 -> 75) -- despite QODEC being byte-lossless and ~22% cheaper in input tokens. Principal (Gemma-4-31B-it): equal correct count (12/12) but 4 hard regressions -> not non-inferior.
next_step_per_protocol: MODEL_QUALITY_REGRESSION_DESPITE_STRUCTURAL_PASS -> stop generalization work; do NOT build qodec project v1 and do NOT start the real-source holdout. Investigate the representation/instruction boundary first: the failure is specifically accurate identifier extraction from the %q1 legend. No notation tuning was done after seeing outputs (L1 prohibition respected).
